caption: Each of the SaaS CRM's four controls is tagged with its owner: the data centre and hypervisor patching are the provider's, the key policy and role assignment are the customer's. The tally at the bottom is two provider and two customer controls; the 500 users, 3 roles and 90-day logs are inputs, not results.

spec.title: SaaS CRM: who owns each control
spec.aria: A SaaS CRM with 500 users and 3 roles leads through four controls in order: data centre physical security (provider), key policy (customer), role assignment (customer) and hypervisor patching (provider), ending in a tally of two provider and two customer controls.
